en-US.title: Prism Duel
en-US.subtitle: Pixel-Art Hologram Card Duels
en-US.promoText: One purchase, the whole game: 80 cards, every monster with its own pixel-art summon and attack. No ads, no in-app purchases — just duels.
en-US.description:
Prism Duel is a fast, tactical card duel in a glowing isometric arena.

Build a deck from 80 original cards — dragons, golems, knights, spells and traps — then summon them as living holograms and battle for the last Life Point.

FEATURES
• Every monster has its own summon, attack and defeat animation, and its own sound
• Duel the CPU, or pass the phone and play a friend on the same screen
• Deck builder with presets, auto-fill and a level curve — drag cards in, drag them out
• Spells, traps, tributes, direct attacks and comebacks in short, readable turns
• Hand-drawn pixel art with soft real-time lighting that fills the whole screen on modern iPhones

ONE PURCHASE, THE WHOLE GAME
• All 80 cards and every mode are included — nothing to unlock, nothing to buy later
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Plays fully offline
• No data collected — your decks stay on your iPhone

review.notes: No login or account needed. On the title screen tap anywhere, choose VERSUS CPU, pick a deck (e.g. Classic Deck) and play. Tap a card in your hand to summon or set it; tap BATTLE to attack. The game is fully offline and collects no data. All card names, characters and art are original.
